crossRefs.note: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries, and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean. How long will it yet be?”
translations.bsb: Your adulteries and lustful neighings, your shameless prostitution on the hills and in the fields— I have seen your detestable acts. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! How long will you remain unclean?”
translations.kjv: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once
